words.definition: n. 让步，妥协；特许权；承认

examples.en: Both sides made significant concessions to reach the agreement.
examples.zh: 双方都作出了重大让步以达成协议。

examples.en: The government granted the company a concession to operate the railway.
examples.zh: 政府授予该公司铁路特许经营权。

words.usage: 与 concede 同根；make a concession to sb（向某人让步），谈判中常用复数 concessions；也指「特许经营权」。派生：concede vt. 让步，承认。
collocations: make a concession 作出让步
mutual concessions 互相让步
a concession to reality 对现实的妥协
words.mnemonic: con+cess(让)+ion→让出去→让步；同根concede

words.definition: n. 方向，方位；指导，管理；（复）说明书

examples.en: The company is moving in the direction of greater environmental responsibility.
examples.zh: 公司正朝着更注重环境责任的方向发展。

examples.en: The research was conducted under the direction of a senior professor.
examples.zh: 这项研究是在一位资深教授的指导下进行的。

words.usage: 表「朝…方向」用 in the direction of；「在…指导下」用 under the direction of；复数表「说明书」。派生：direct vt. 指引；director n. 主管。
collocations: in the direction of 朝…方向
under the direction of 在…指导下
sense of direction 方向感
words.mnemonic: direct(指引)+ion→指引的方向；引申为指导

words.definition: n. 舌头；语言；口才

examples.en: English is not her mother tongue, yet she writes with remarkable fluency.
examples.zh: 英语并非她的母语，但她写作却极为流畅。

examples.en: He had to bite his tongue to avoid an argument with his boss.
examples.zh: 他只好忍住不说，以免和老板起争执。

words.usage: 「母语」说 mother tongue；hold your tongue（保持沉默）；on the tip of one's tongue（话到嘴边想不起）。g 不发音，勿多读。

synonyms.note: 泛指语言；tongue 多指母语

collocations: mother tongue 母语
hold one's tongue 保持沉默
a sharp tongue 说话刻薄
words.mnemonic: 谐音「烫」：舌头烫得直吐→舌头；引申语言口才

words.definition: n. 困境，进退两难；两难抉择

examples.en: The doctor faced the dilemma of whether to tell the patient the truth.
examples.zh: 医生面临着是否告诉病人真相的两难抉择。

examples.en: She was caught in a dilemma between career and family.
examples.zh: 她陷入了事业与家庭之间的两难境地。

words.usage: 常用 be caught in/face a dilemma（陷入或面临两难）；be on the horns of a dilemma（进退维谷）。勿误拼 dilemna。常见搭配 moral dilemma。
collocations: face a dilemma 面临困境
moral dilemma 道德困境
a way out of the dilemma 摆脱困境的办法
words.mnemonic: di(二)+lemma(命题)→两难命题→进退两难

words.definition: n. 掌声，喝彩；赞许

examples.en: The pianist received thunderous applause at the end of her performance.
examples.zh: 钢琴家演出结束时赢得了雷鸣般的掌声。

examples.en: His speech drew warm applause from the audience.
examples.zh: 他的演讲赢得了观众热烈的掌声。

words.usage: 动词 applaud 的名词，不可数；a burst of applause（一阵掌声）；draw applause（赢得掌声）；thunderous applause（雷鸣般的掌声）。
collocations: a burst of applause 一阵掌声
thunderous applause 雷鸣般的掌声
a round of applause 一轮掌声
words.mnemonic: ap+plaus(拍手)+e→拍手喝彩→掌声；plausible同根

words.definition: n. （政府的）部；（总称）部长职位；牧师职分

examples.en: The Ministry of Education announced a reform of the college entrance examination.
examples.zh: 教育部宣布了一项高考改革。

examples.en: He served in the Ministry of Defense for over a decade.
examples.zh: 他在国防部任职十余年。

words.usage: 「外交部」the Ministry of Foreign Affairs；英式多说 ministry，美式多说 department。派生：minister n. 部长；ministerial adj. 部长的。
collocations: the Ministry of Education 教育部
Ministry of Finance 财政部
a government ministry 政府部门
words.mnemonic: minister(部长)+y→部长执掌的部门→（政府的）部

words.definition: vt. 鼓掌；称赞，赞许

examples.en: The audience applauded the performers for nearly ten minutes.
examples.zh: 观众为演员们鼓掌喝彩将近十分钟。

examples.en: Critics applauded the government's efforts to reduce poverty.
examples.zh: 评论人士赞许政府的扶贫努力。

words.usage: 及物动词直接接宾语：applaud the decision（称赞决定）；applaud sb for sth（因某事称赞某人）。派生：applause n. 掌声；applaudable adj. 值得称赞的。

synonyms.note: 泛指赞扬，口语书面皆可

collocations: applaud the decision 为决定鼓掌
widely applauded 广受赞誉
applaud sb for sth 因某事称赞某人
words.mnemonic: ap(一再)+plaud(拍手)→鼓掌；引申口头称赞

words.definition: n. 食欲，胃口；强烈欲望

examples.en: Regular exercise can improve your appetite and overall health.
examples.zh: 经常锻炼能改善食欲和整体健康。

examples.en: His appetite for power eventually led to his downfall.
examples.zh: 他对权力的欲望最终导致了他的垮台。

words.usage: 本义「胃口」：have a good appetite（胃口好）；引申「欲望」接 for：an appetite for knowledge（求知欲）。派生：appetizer n. 开胃菜。
collocations: lose one's appetite 失去胃口
an appetite for knowledge 求知欲
spoil one's appetite 破坏食欲
words.mnemonic: ap+pet(追求)+ite→追求食物→食欲；求知欲

words.definition: vi. 进餐，用饭；vt. 宴请

examples.en: They dined at an Italian restaurant to celebrate the anniversary.
examples.zh: 他们在一家意大利餐厅用餐，庆祝结婚纪念日。

examples.en: The company wined and dined its potential investors.
examples.zh: 公司盛宴款待了潜在投资者。

words.usage: 正式用语「用餐」：dine out（外出就餐）；wine and dine sb（盛宴款待）。派生：diner n. 用餐者，餐车；dining room 餐厅。
collocations: dine out 外出就餐
wine and dine sb 盛情款待
dining car 餐车
words.mnemonic: dinner(正餐)的动词形→用餐；dine out 下馆子

words.definition: vi. 摸索，探寻；vt. 摸索着找

examples.en: He groped for his glasses on the bedside table in the dark.
examples.zh: 他在黑暗中摸索着找床头柜上的眼镜。

examples.en: Scientists are still groping for an explanation of the phenomenon.
examples.zh: 科学家仍在探求对这一现象的解释。

words.usage: grope for sth（摸索着找）；grope one's way（摸索前进）；grope for words（搜寻措辞）多作比喻义。个别引申义有冒犯色彩，正式场合慎用。

confusables.note: 葡萄；中间 o 换 a
抱怨；中间 i 换 o

collocations: grope for the light switch 摸索电灯开关
grope one's way 摸索前行
grope for answers 搜寻答案
words.mnemonic: g+rope(绳)→抓着绳子摸黑走→摸索

words.definition: n. 肢，臂，腿；大树枝

examples.en: The accident left him without sensation in his lower limbs.
examples.zh: 事故使他的下肢失去了知觉。

examples.en: She went out on a limb to defend an unpopular opinion.
examples.zh: 她冒着风险为一个不受欢迎的观点辩护。

words.usage: b 不发音；四肢合称 limbs；树的主枝也叫 limb。习语 go out on a limb（冒险表态、孤立无援）；risk life and limb（冒生命危险）。

synonyms.note: 树枝泛称；limb 指大主枝

collocations: go out on a limb 冒险表态
escape with life and limb 幸免于难
lower limbs 下肢
words.mnemonic: climb(爬)含limb：爬树摔伤limb→四肢；b不发音

words.definition: prep. 减去；n. 负号，缺点；adj. 负的

examples.en: The temperature dropped to minus fifteen degrees overnight.
examples.zh: 一夜之间气温降到了零下十五度。

examples.en: Lack of experience is clearly a minus in this job interview.
examples.zh: 缺乏经验在这场求职面试中显然是个不利因素。

words.usage: 数学表「减」：seven minus three（七减三）；a minus sign（负号）；引申指「缺点、不利因素」，可数。反义词 plus（加）。
collocations: a minus sign 负号
minus ten degrees 零下十度
a definite minus 明显的缺点
words.mnemonic: min(小)+us→变少了→减去；反义plus(加)

words.definition: n. 音乐会，演奏会；一致，协作

examples.en: The band will give a charity concert at the end of this month.
examples.zh: 乐队将于本月底举办一场慈善音乐会。

examples.en: The two firms acted in concert to push up prices.
examples.zh: 两家公司联手抬高了价格。

words.usage: 「听音乐会」go to a concert；in concert 表「一致协力、现场演出」：act in concert with sb（与某人协同行动），考研常考。
collocations: go to a concert 去听音乐会
in concert with 与…协力
a live concert 现场音乐会
words.mnemonic: con(共同)+cert→同台献艺→音乐会；in concert协力

words.definition: adj. 语言的；语言学的

examples.en: Children show remarkable linguistic ability long before formal schooling.
examples.zh: 孩子们在正式上学之前就展现出惊人的语言能力。

examples.en: Trade between the two regions overcame linguistic and cultural barriers.
examples.zh: 两地间的贸易克服了语言和文化障碍。

words.usage: 学科名词用复数 linguistics（语言学）；linguistic barriers（语言障碍）为阅读高频搭配。派生：linguist n. 语言学家；bilingual adj. 双语的。

synonyms.note: 与言辞相关的，侧重用词

collocations: linguistic diversity 语言多样性
linguistic barriers 语言障碍
linguistic skills 语言能力
words.mnemonic: lingu(语言)+istic→语言的；bilingual双语同根

words.definition: adj. 大约的，近似的；vt. 接近，近似

examples.en: The approximate cost of the project is two million dollars.
examples.zh: 该项目的大致成本为两百万美元。

examples.en: His description of the event approximates to the truth.
examples.zh: 他对事件的描述接近事实真相。

words.usage: adj. 表「大约的」：an approximate figure（约数）；动词表「接近」：approximate to sth，重音移至末音节。派生：approximately adv. 大约。
collocations: approximate number 大概的数目
approximate value 近似值
approximate to 接近
words.mnemonic: ap+proxim(接近)+ate→接近的→大约的

words.definition: n. 器械，设备，装置；机构，组织

examples.en: The laboratory has purchased new apparatus for the experiment.
examples.zh: 实验室为这项实验购置了新仪器。

examples.en: The state apparatus was used to suppress political opposition.
examples.zh: 国家机器被用来镇压政治反对派。

words.usage: 「实验器械」laboratory apparatus；单复数同形（亦作 apparatuses）；the apparatus of government 指「政府机构」。常作集合名词。
collocations: laboratory apparatus 实验仪器
gymnastic apparatus 体操器械
the apparatus of government 政府机构
words.mnemonic: ap+parat(准备)+us→备好的器具→器械

words.definition: adj. 勤奋的，勤勉的；细致的

examples.en: Years of diligent research finally produced a breakthrough.
examples.zh: 多年勤勉的研究终于带来了突破。

examples.en: She was diligent in reviewing every contract before signing.
examples.zh: 她在签署前认真审阅每一份合同。

words.usage: be diligent in sth（在…上勤奋），后接 about 亦可。派生：diligence n. 勤勉；diligently adv. 勤恳地。口语近义 hardworking。
collocations: a diligent student 勤奋的学生
be diligent in one's work 勤勉工作
diligent preparation 细致的准备
words.mnemonic: 谐音「地里勤」：在地里勤快劳作→勤奋的

words.definition: adj. 兼容的；合得来的；与…不矛盾的

examples.en: The software is not compatible with older operating systems.
examples.zh: 该软件与旧版操作系统不兼容。

examples.en: A healthy work-life balance is compatible with career success.
examples.zh: 健康的工作生活平衡与事业成功并不矛盾。

words.usage: 固定搭配 be compatible with（与…兼容、不矛盾）；反义 incompatible。派生：compatibility n. 兼容性。主语多为物，亦可指人「合得来」。
collocations: be compatible with 与…兼容
compatible software 兼容软件
mutually compatible 互不冲突
words.mnemonic: com(共)+pat(感受)+ible→感受相通→合得来、兼容

words.definition: n. 化合物，复合物；大院；adj. 复合的；vt. 使加剧

examples.en: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
examples.zh: 水是氢和氧的化合物。

examples.en: The shortage of funds only compounded the difficulties of the project.
examples.zh: 资金短缺只会加剧项目的困难。

words.usage: 名词表「化合物」：chemical compound；compound interest（复利）；动词表「使加剧」：compound a problem，重音移后。
collocations: chemical compound 化合物
compound interest 复利
compound a problem 使问题加剧
words.mnemonic: com(一起)+pound(捣)→捣在一起→化合物；引申加剧

words.definition: adj. 紧凑的，小巧的；（文体）简洁的；vt. 压紧

examples.en: The apartment is compact but well designed.
examples.zh: 这套公寓面积紧凑，但设计精巧。

examples.en: The editor condensed the report into a compact summary.
examples.zh: 编辑把报告压缩成一份简洁的摘要。

words.usage: 形容小而实用：a compact car（小型车）；文体简洁：a compact style。名词表「契约」，重音移前。派生：compactly adv. 紧凑地。
collocations: a compact car 小型轿车
compact design 紧凑的设计
a compact style 简洁的文体
words.mnemonic: com+pact(压紧)→压紧的→紧凑的；pact协定
